====================================
Painter Nodes (these are designed for wan2.2)
====================================

Highly recommended over comfy nodes for improved motion and less spagetti.

PainterI2V: https://github.com/princepainter/ComfyUI-PainterI2V
PainterSampler: https://github.com/princepainter/Comfyui-PainterSampler
PainterLongVideo: https://github.com/princepainter/ComfyUI-PainterLongVideo

====================================
(Optional) Speed Boosts
====================================

Be sure to only use woct0rdho's Triton, SageAttention, SpargeAttn and RadialAttn together. If you mix it with others, you'll get many errors. This benefits if you want to do 10 seconds +/162 frames.

Triton: https://github.com/woct0rdho/triton-windows
SageAttention: https://github.com/woct0rdho/SageAttention/releases
SpargeAttn: https://github.com/woct0rdho/SpargeAttn
RadialAttn: https://github.com/woct0rdho/ComfyUI-RadialAttn

Then install the radialattn node. You can disable all of these nodes as its not required :)
